verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's get-started docs list three official SDKs with install commands: Go (github.com/sandbox0-ai/sdk-go), Python (pip install sandbox0) and TypeScript (npm install sandbox0), plus API-key setup. The Python SDK also backs a documented OpenAI Agents SDK adapter, and other docs reference SDK-driven workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence of in-depth SDK API reference docs (no OpenAPI spec was found).
